Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second turn (Step 2), the WebSurfer incorrectly identified the manufacturer of the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V as "Lockheed Martin Company" in the search results summary. This is a severe historical error; the missile was developed by the Glenn L. Martin Company in the early 1950s, long before Lockheed Martin was formed (which happened in 1995). This hallucination likely stemmed from a search engine result snippet error or a failure to distinguish between the historical "Glenn L. Martin Company" and the modern "Lockheed Martin" in the provided text, leading the agent to propagate false information about the builder.
